summary: The source contract fixes every legal input at exactly 32 bit positions, so no honest runtime-scaling dimension exists within the problem domain.

workload_bound.source_constraint: The source-fidelity-verified contract requires reversal of one fixed-width 32-bit integer, including leading zero positions.

replacement_checks.evidence: The loop executes exactly 32 iterations. Each iteration performs one result shift, one low-bit mask and append, and one input shift, proving O(1) time and O(1) auxiliary space under the fixed-width contract.
Black-box real-test execution verifies every existing ordinary check without inspecting its definition, including leading-zero placement and the integer return path.
